expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Scaffold with TODO stubs, not a full implementation: 'bocker_pull() { echo "bocker: pull 尚未实现 (M2)" >&2; exit 1; }' (same for run/ps/logs/rm/images/cleanup), plus '# M2 TODO: bocker_pull <repo> <tag>'. Learner is told to implement it: '你要写的核心（`bocker/bocker` 里的 `bocker_pull`，约 20 行）… 先动手写，卡住了把报错贴给我，我们从真实输出开始调。' Only M1 (dispatch/help) is done; M2-M6 are staged milestones.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Concrete checkpoint with command and expected result in the final section: '4. 结束后 `ls` 一下镜像目录确认有 `/bin/sh`' and milestone table 'M2 | `./bocker pull alpine 3.19` 后 `bocker_images/alpine_3.19/bin/sh` 存在'; M1 checkpoint already verified: '骨架已建好并通过冒烟测试' via 'bocker/tests/smoke.sh'.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (docker-docker-shell): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Tutorial-specific stages and concepts matching p8952/bocker: 'M2 | bocker pull | Registry v2 API：匿名 token → manifest → 逐层下载 blob → tar 解包', 'M3 … unshare(mount/pid/uts/ipc) + chroot 进镜像目录 + 容器内挂 /proc', 'M4 cgroups | cgroup v2 memory.max / pids.max', 'M6 网络 veth pair + bridge + NAT', with registry details 'auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:<repo>:pull' and manifest-index indirection; bash language, '~100 行' target.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: All 3 shell commands are read-only or in-project: 'ls .agents/skills/… | grep', 'uname -a; id; ls -la; … which curl wget unshare btrfs', 'chmod +x bocker/bocker bocker/tests/smoke.sh && bocker/tests/smoke.sh' — no install commands. All 4 files written under bocker/ (bocker, README.md, PROGRESS.md, tests/smoke.sh). Linux requirement is deferred to the learner: '到时用 privileged 容器或 Linux VM 跑即可：docker run --privileged …'.
